instruction: Implement only the requirement in the frozen browser page. Replace the single /* MODEL_BEHAVIOR */ marker with vanilla JavaScript statements using the provided app API. Data shapes: app.viewer() returns a string; comment.author.username is a string. Register app.onView. Do not change any other byte of the page. Return only the complete HTML page.

arms.A: Render the article comment's Delete action on the article page. Show its button only if the signed-in viewer is the comment's author.
arms.B: Render the article comment's Delete action on the article page. Show its button only when the signed-in viewer wrote that comment.
arms.C: Render the article comment's Delete action on the article page.
